description: Verify that the IPv4-Address field of the IPv4 Multicast Option is eventgroup multicast IP (SOME/IP-SD §5.1.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Wire-format invariant for the IPv4 Multicast Option: IPv4-Address == eventgroup multicast IP.

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT emits a qualifying SD message containing the option (typically an OfferService).
Observation: option's IPv4-Address field == eventgroup multicast IP.   ← key check

[Pass condition]
IPv4-Address on the wire equals eventgroup multicast IP.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_ipv4 — IPv4 multicast address mismatch
• Fail_timeout — no qualifying SD message within listen window

verdicts.Pass: IPv4 Multicast Option IPv4-Address = eventgroup multicast IP — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying SD message within listen window
